description: Implementation of the AudioRendererSink class for managing audio sink operations, including starting, stopping, volume control, and callback handling within the starboard shared starboard player filter namespace.

classes.name: AudioRendererSinkImpl
classes.description: Class implementing audio sink functionalities including start, stop, volume, playback rate, and callback management.

methods.name: AudioRendererSinkImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing with default or custom create_audio_sink_func.

methods.name: IsAudioSampleTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific audio sample type is supported.

methods.name: IsAudioFrameStorageTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific audio frame storage type is supported.

methods.name: GetNearestSupportedSampleFrequency
methods.description: Returns the nearest supported sample frequency for a given value.

methods.name: HasStarted
methods.description: Returns whether the sink has been started.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the audio sink with specified parameters and callback.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops and destroys the audio sink.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the audio sink.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate, supporting only 0 (pause) or 1 (play).
